title: engage.campaign.campaign.send_requested
description: A draft campaign passed the send gate. `notification.consumers.expand_campaign_send` is what turns this into `queued` recipient rows; nothing here has sent anything yet. A scheduled send (`POST /engage/campaigns/{id}/schedule`) reaches the same handler later: `notification.services.schedule_send` stages it as the target of a `platform.schedule.requested`, the scheduler republishes it unchanged at `due_at`, and `scheduled_for` — the instant that request was made for — is what lets the handler drop a firing a reschedule or a cancel has since superseded.

scheduled_for.description: Present only on a scheduled send: the `scheduled_at` this firing was requested for, compared with the campaign's current `scheduled_at` before it is activated. Absent on an immediate send, whose campaign is already `sending` when this is published.
